name: Dialog
summary: A modal dialog opened with no script; the browser handles focus, Esc and the inert page.

guidance.useFor: A task or decision that must be finished before going on: confirming a deletion, a short form.
insteadUse: Information people may want beside the page: Popover or Toggletip
Long or multi-step tasks: a page
Filters or navigation from an edge: Drawer
content: The title asks or names the task ("Delete this project?")
Buttons say what they do ("Delete", "Cancel"), never "Yes" and "No"

rungReason: <dialog> gives modality, inertness, top layer and Esc; invoker commands open it without script; <form method="dialog"> closes it with a return value.

keyboard.action: Close (cancel event; may be prevented once to confirm discarding changes)
Move focus within the dialog; the page behind is inert

focus.initial: Element with autofocus, else the first focusable element
focus.return: Browser returns focus to the invoker on close

props.open: controlled; opens with showModal(), never React's open attribute
props.onOpenChange: required with open: the dialog closes itself on Esc, light dismiss and form method=dialog

enhancements.fallback: No light dismiss; Esc and the dialog's buttons close it (older Safari). Works in Chromium, Firefox and Playwright's WebKit 27.2, checked 2026-10-24

knownGaps.policy: ADR-0004 - no polyfill; the React path opens from state

motion: Fades and scales in (enter easing) and out (exit easing) with @starting-style; the backdrop fades. Durations are 0s under reduced motion
contrast: Increased contrast and reduced transparency: opaque surface, solid ring
forcedColors: Canvas / CanvasText with a visible border; the chrome ring is removed; ::backdrop stays transparent-dark
rules: Never pass React's open prop (opens non-modal without inertness)
Popovers inside the dialog stay DOM children of the dialog (never portalled)
Scroll lock: html:has(.lue-dialog:modal) { overflow: hidden } with scrollbar-gutter: stable
